'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[2025 Gaza Strip aid distribution killings]], [[Gaza Strip famine]]
***At least 74 [[Palestinians]] are killed by [[Israel]]i gunfire and airstrikes, including ten seeking [[humanitarian aid|aid]], and another five Palestinians die of [[starvation]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/more-gazans-die-seeking-aid-hunger-burial-shrouds-short-supply-2025-08-04/ (Reuters)] [https://www.channel4.com/news/74-palestinians-killed-in-gaza-as-video-of-israeli-hostages-puts-pressure-on-netanyahu (Channel 4 News)]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli prime minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] announces that the [[Israeli government]] has decided to completely [[Israel Defense Forces|militarily]] [[military occupation|occupy]] the [[Gaza Strip]] and fully eliminate [[Hamas]], and tells [[Chief of the General Staff (Israel)|Chief of the General Staff]] [[Eyal Zamir]] to resign. [https://www.euronews.com/2025/08/04/netanyahu-says-decision-made-for-full-occupation-of-gaza (Euronews)]
*[[Islamic State insurgency in Puntland]]
**[[Puntland counter-terrorism operations]]
***[[Puntland Dervish Force|Puntland]] and [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. forces]] conduct a counter-terrorism operation in [[Sanaag]], [[Puntland]], detaining three [[Islamic State]] militants. [https://trackingterrorism.org/chatter/puntland-forces-detain-three-iss-militants-in-humbeis/ (Tracking Terrorism)]

'''Business and economy'''
*Over 10,000 hotel owners in Europe, represented by the [[Hotel rating#European Hotelstars Union|HOTREC]] union, file a joint lawsuit against [[Netherlands]]-based travel agency [[Booking.com]] seeking compensation for losses from 2004 to 2024, alleging that the booking agency prevented the hotels from offering lower prices on their own sites. [https://www.dw.com/en/over-10000-hotels-join-complaint-against-bookingcom/a-73526132 (DW)] [https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/dutch-consumer-groups-prepare-legal-action-against-bookingcom-alleging-inflated-2025-06-26/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Eight people are killed and two others are injured in a [[vehicle collision]] on the [[List of federal highways in Brazil#Link highways|BR-491]] highway in [[Guaxupé]], [[Minas Gerais]], [[Brazil]]. [https://g1.globo.com/mg/sul-de-minas/noticia/2025/08/04/oito-pessoas-morrem-e-duas-ficam-feridas-apos-acidente-na-br-491-em-guaxupe-mg.ghtml?UTM_SOURCE=copiar-url&UTM_MEDIUM=share-bar-app&UTM_CAMPAIGN=materias&UTM_TERM=app-webview (G1 Globo)]
*Three people are killed and 18 others are injured in a [[multiple-vehicle collision]] on the [[Autostrada A1 (Italy)|Autostrada A1]] in [[Montevarchi]], [[Province of Arezzo]], [[Italy]]. [https://www.arezzonotizie.it/video/video-incidente-a1-morti-oggi.html (Arezzo Notizie)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2025 Cambodia–Thailand border conflict]], [[Cambodia–Thailand relations]]
**Delegates from [[Cambodia]] and [[Thailand]] meet in [[Malaysia]], the current [[ASEAN]] chair seat, to negotiate a long-term [[ceasefire]] at their [[Cambodia–Thailand border|border]] following clashes that killed dozens of people and displaced over 270,000 others. [https://apnews.com/article/thailand-cambodia-border-military-peace-talks-ceasefire-dbbbce46a5f2317bf6ef0e9f939d9736 (AP)]
*[[India–Philippines relations]], [[Territorial disputes in the South China Sea]]
**The [[Indian Navy|Indian]] and [[Philippine Navy|Philippine navies]] conduct their first joint [[Military exercise|exercise]] in the Philippine-[[West Philippine Sea|designated]] [[Exclusive economic zone of the Philippines|exclusive economic zone]] in the [[South China Sea]]. The Indian Navy deployed [[Guided-missile destroyer|guided missile destroyers]], tankers, and [[corvette]]s, while the Philippines sent two [[frigate]]s. [https://apnews.com/article/india-philippines-south-china-sea-joint-sail-eecfaa6056d71937716fb4dc22f52b8a (AP)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/philippines-india-hold-first-joint-sail-south-china-sea-2025-08-04/ (Reuters)]
